title: Security Settings
description: Learn how to configure security settings, enable two-factor authentication, and protect your Matjrii account.
content:
Security Settings

Configure security settings to protect your Matjrii account, data, and customer information from unauthorized access and threats.

Password Security

Manage password security:

  • Change password regularly
  • Use strong passwords
  • Password requirements
  • Password expiration
  • Password history

Two-Factor Authentication

Enable two-factor authentication (2FA):

  • Add extra security layer
  • Use authenticator apps
  • SMS-based 2FA
  • Backup codes
  • Recovery options

Session Management

Manage user sessions:

  • Session timeout
  • Concurrent sessions
  • Session history
  • Remote logout
  • Active sessions view

Login Security

Configure login security:

  • Login attempt limits
  • Account lockout
  • IP whitelisting
  • Login notifications
  • Login history

API Security

Secure API access:

  • API key management
  • API rate limiting
  • IP restrictions
  • API usage monitoring
  • Revoke API keys

Data Protection

Protect your data:

  • Data encryption
  • Backup settings
  • Data retention policies
  • GDPR compliance
  • Privacy settings

Security Monitoring

Monitor security:

  • Security logs
  • Suspicious activity alerts
  • Failed login attempts
  • Unauthorized access attempts
  • Security reports

Access Control

Control access:

  • User permissions
  • Role-based access
  • IP restrictions
  • Time-based access
  • Geographic restrictions

Best Practices

  • Enable two-factor authentication
  • Use strong, unique passwords
  • Review security logs regularly
  • Keep software updated
  • Limit API access
  • Monitor for suspicious activity
  • Regular security audits

  • Roles & Permissions
  • Company Settings
